description: Live multichain bridge and swap quote via LI.FI across supported EVM & Solana chains (with custom routing notes for X1 and Arc): estimated output USD, total fees, duration, execution steps, and unsigned tx when fromAddress is supplied. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

amount.description: exact input amount in atomic base units (e.g. 10000000 = 10 USDC)

fromAddress.description: optional sender wallet (EVM 0x or Solana base58) to generate unsigned transactionRequest

fromChain.description: source chain slug or ID (e.g. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, solana, arc, x1)

fromToken.description: source token symbol (e.g. USDC, ETH, SOL) or contract/mint address

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

slippage.description: optional max fractional slippage (0.0001 to 0.5, default 0.005)

toAddress.description: optional recipient wallet (EVM 0x or Solana base58)

toChain.description: destination chain slug or ID (e.g. base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, solana, arc, x1)

toToken.description: destination token symbol or contract/mint address

name: cross_chain_quote
title: Cross chain quote
